Questions & Answers

Vendor FAQs

Who can apply to exhibit at Happy Hearts Co. events? +
Any small business, home baker, artisan, or women entrepreneur is welcome to apply. We especially encourage first-time sellers and women-led brands. Products must be original, handmade, or home-produced — we don't accept resellers.
How far in advance do I need to apply? +
We recommend applying at least 2–3 weeks before the event date. Spots fill up quickly, especially for Featured and Corner stalls. Once you apply, our team responds within 2 business days.
What is included with my stall booking? +
All stall packages include the display space, furniture, pre-event social media promotion, inclusion in the event directory, and on-ground setup support. Featured and Corner stalls receive additional marketing and placement benefits.
Do I need to bring my own display materials? +
We provide the table and chairs. You are responsible for your own display setup — tablecloths, shelving, signage, and any custom fixtures. Our team is happy to advise on display best practices before the event.
Is there a refund policy if I can't make it? +
Cancellations made 7+ days before the event receive a 50% refund. Cancellations within 7 days are non-refundable, but we can defer your booking to the next event in the same city at no additional charge (subject to availability).
Can food vendors participate? +
Yes! Home bakers, home chefs, packaged food brands, and artisan food makers are very welcome. You will need to ensure your products comply with local FSSAI regulations. Ready-to-eat cooked food (hot food stalls) is event-specific — please mention this in your application.
